title: Fuel Composition Sensor Range/Performance
shortDescription: Fuel composition sensor signal is out of expected range.
fullDescription: DTC P0177: Fuel composition sensor signal is out of expected range. The PCM uses fuel composition and temperature sensors to adapt injection timing and quantity for flex-fuel and cold-start operation. A failed sensor causes incorrect mixture and driveability complaints.
safetyImpact: Incorrect fuel mixture causes hesitation, hard starting, and elevated emissions but is not an immediate safety risk.
symptoms: Rough idle when fuel composition changes

fixSteps.title: Scan Fuel Data
fixSteps.instruction: Read live data for fuel composition (alcohol %), fuel temperature, and short/long term fuel trims. Compare to expected ranges.

fixSteps.title: Inspect Sensor and Wiring
fixSteps.instruction: Locate the flex-fuel / fuel temp sensor on the fuel line. Check the connector for corrosion and the wiring for chafe or open.

fixSteps.title: Test Sensor Output
fixSteps.instruction: Back-probe the sensor signal with key on, engine running. Verify voltage or frequency follows fuel temperature / ethanol content per spec.

fixSteps.title: Replace Sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Relieve fuel pressure, replace the sensor, prime the system, and clear codes. Drive cycle to confirm fix.

faq.q: Will fresh fuel clear this code?
faq.a: If the cause was contaminated or wrong-grade fuel, draining and refilling with the correct grade often resolves it after a relearn.

faq.q: Is this a sensor or a fuel issue?
faq.a: Fuel trims and the alcohol percentage reading at the scan tool will tell you — implausible values point to the sensor, plausible values point to fuel quality.

faq.q: Can I keep driving?
faq.a: Yes, but expect drivability issues. Fix promptly to avoid further unburned fuel washing oil from the bores.
